verdict.rationale: Gmail filters can evaluate incoming mail by sender, subject, or size and automatically apply labels. Combined with search operators and 'filtering and sorting of messages', that lets a user build label-based streams such as team or newsletters. The evidence never shows a native split-inbox view or priority-ordered triage, so the streams have to be assembled by hand from filters and labels. Missing for 10: native split/multiple-inbox or category-tab view, automatic importance detection, calendar-invite stream, priority-ordered triage, independent hands-on corroboration.
